with high confidence. The fix addresses the root cause:
| Before | After |
|--------|-------|
| for await (const value of stream.fullStream) hangs indefinitely if no data arrives | withIdleTimeout(stream.fullStream, 60000, abort) throws after 60s of no data |
| No recovery mechanism for stalled streams | StreamIdleTimeoutError triggers automatic retry with exponential backoff |
Pushed to Repository
- Branch: fix/stream-idle-timeout
- Commits: 2 (fix + tests)
- URL: https://github.com/dzianisv/opencode/tree/fix/stream-idle-timeout
The fix is ready for real-world testing. To fully validate, you could:
1. Build and run OpenCode from this branch
2. Start a long LLM request
3. Disconnect network mid-stream
4. Verify it retries instead of hanging forever

Thanks for the credit for finding the issue, but I think with this new solution OAuth Codex behavior is still different from non-OAuth Codex:

OAuth Codex path

- `isCodex` detection: `packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts` line 65
  https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts#L65
- Base Codex prompt always sent via `options.instructions`: `packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts` lines 114-115
  https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts#L114-L115
- System bundle (agent.prompt + input.system + input.user.system) sent as system messages: `packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts` lines 67-80 and 235-241
  https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts#L67-L80
  https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts#L235-L241

Non-OAuth Codex (Zen/opencode)

- `isCodex` is false, so system bundle uses `agent.prompt` if present, otherwise provider prompt: `packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts` lines 70-72
  https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts#L70-L72
- Provider prompt selection includes PROMPT_CODEX for gpt-5 models: `packages/opencode/src/session/system.ts` lines 18-20
  https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/system.ts#L18-L20

Resulting behavior:

- OAuth Codex keeps PROMPT_CODEX (via `options.instructions`) and appends custom agent prompt + env/AGENTS as system/developer messages.
- Non-OAuth Codex REPLACES the PROMPT_CODEX with `agent.prompt` when present.

So behavior still differs (append vs replace). Assumning parity is desired, we likely need to either:

1. For OAuth: set `options.instructions` to `agent.prompt ?? PROMPT_CODEX` and append `input.system`, or
2. For non-OAuth: always include base prompt even when agent prompt is present.

Also `input.system` is env + AGENTS.md: `packages/opencode/src/session/prompt.ts` line 605
https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/prompt.ts#L605
